offerings.name: Custom web platforms
offerings.description: We design and build production web platforms end to end, from data model and API through to the interface your customers use every day. For hotels4truckers we delivered a complete booking platform that lets drivers find and reserve truck-friendly parking, taking the client from concept to a live, revenue-earning product without stitching together separate vendors.

offerings.name: Native mobile apps (iOS & Android)
offerings.description: We ship native iOS and Android apps that share a backend with your web product, so customers get a consistent experience on every device. On the hotels4truckers engagement we built the mobile apps alongside the web platform, giving drivers on the road the same search, booking, and reservation flow they get on the desktop.

offerings.name: AI & RAG systems
offerings.description: We integrate language models into your product with retrieval-augmented generation grounded in your own data, so answers stay accurate and traceable instead of made up. For purlpal we built a chatbot that answers questions about Medicare Advantage plans by retrieving from current plan data, turning a dense benefits catalog into a conversation members can actually use.

offerings.name: Data pipelines & web scraping
offerings.description: We build the pipelines that keep your product's data current, collecting from external sources, cleaning it, and loading it where your application can use it. For purlpal we implemented the web scraping that continuously refreshes Medicare Advantage plan data, so the assistant answers from up-to-date information rather than a stale snapshot.

offerings.name: Workflow automation & desktop tools
offerings.description: We replace slow, manual, error-prone workflows with software that does the repetitive work for your team. That ranges from desktop applications for regulated back-office tasks to automations that move data between the systems you already run, giving your staff hours back and removing the mistakes that come from hand-keying the same information twice.

offerings.name: Compliance-grade document automation
offerings.description: We turn recurring compliance paperwork into a templating engine that produces consistent, audit-ready documents in a fraction of the time. For spendlogic we built a procurement compliance documentation engine that generates the required templates automatically, so their team can stand behind every document while spending far less effort assembling it.
